subject: Clarifying the new due dates
text: Hi PM, Just wanted to check in about the deadline shuffle before I dive too far into the wrong lane. I saw the note saying the donor report is now due Wednesday, but my volunteer checklist still shows Friday. Are we talking Wednesday end of day or Wednesday morning-ish, since I'm juggling a family thing Thursday and don't want to drop the ball? Also, did the survey summary move too, or is that still riding along with next week's pack? I'm happy to pull my weight and get it wrapped, but if timing is really tight, let me know which piece matters most. No drama at all—just trying to keep things smooth on my end. I noticed the portal flagged the change yesterday evening, and I figured asking now is better than discovering Friday at midnight. If I can help tweak the timeline or slide another task, shoot me a quick message and I'll jump on it. Thanks so much!
